top_signals.title: Manipal Health Eyes India Expansion After IPO Debut
top_signals.summary: Manipal Health Enterprises says its IPO proceeds will help reduce debt and support future growth across India. On Bloomberg's 'Insight with Haslinda Amin,' Group COO Karthik Rajagopal spoke exclusively about valuation concerns, expansion plans, acquisitions and why the company remains focused on the domestic healthcare market. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: WPP slashes jobs as revenue continues to fall
top_signals.summary: Embattled advertiser WPP slashed jobs in the first half of the year as its revenue continued to fall. The London-listed media group cut another 1,267 employees in the first half, around 1.3 per cent of its total staffing. Across the 12 months to June, WPP has now slashed its total workforce by 6.4 per cent [...]
